purpose: The explicit, version-specific partition of `ScoreBreakdown` into crowding-authorized and non-crowding fields, for BOTH arms. Traced in source, then VERIFIED by measurement: the instrument fails loudly (SC5) if any field moves between the full and zero-crowding candidate without being declared here.
